What to Check: Logo, hamburger menu, search/cart/wishlist icons don't overlap or wrap onto a second row.
Headline/CTA text isn't clipped by the image; CTA button fully visible, not cut off at the edge.
Search dropdown/results panel stays within screen width, doesn't get cut off at the right edge.
Cards don't overflow the viewport; arrows don't overlap product title/price; equal card heights.
Image and title stack cleanly; title doesn't overlap the excerpt text.
Email input and button stack vertically (not squished side by side); button text not cut off.
Columns collapse into a single stack (not overlapping); social icons wrap onto their own row cleanly.
Cards wrap to a clean 1-2 column layout; category image aspect ratio not stretched/cropped oddly.
Count text doesn't overlap the heading or wrap awkwardly next to it.
Filters collapse into a button/drawer (not a sidebar squeezing the product grid); drawer opens full-height without cutting off options.
Grid drops to 1-2 columns; price/title text doesn't truncate mid-word; sale/discount badge doesn't overlap the product image.
Dropdown menu opens fully on-screen, not clipped by the viewport edge.
Page number buttons wrap cleanly or scroll horizontally, don't overlap each other.
Thumbnails don't overlap the main image; swipe/zoom doesn't break the page layout.
Size/colour swatches wrap onto new rows cleanly, don't overlap their labels.

Section/Element: Price / Add to Cart / Qty stepper
What to Check: Add to Cart button isn't cut off at the screen edge; +/- stepper buttons aren't squished into the input field.
Tab labels don't overlap or truncate; expanded content doesn't overflow horizontally.
Drawer takes full screen width on mobile; line item image, title, price align cleanly in the row.
+/- buttons and quantity number aren't squished or overlapping.
Remove (x) icon doesn't overlap price or title text.
Checkout button is reachable without awkward scrolling; not cut off below the fold or behind the drawer edge.
Input and Apply button stack or fit side by side without the button text being clipped.
Nav items don't wrap or overlap the logo/icons as the menu switches from mobile to full nav.
Text block and image maintain proportion; no overlapping text at this mid-width.
Card count per row updates cleanly (e.g. 2-3 cards); no half-cut card at the row edge.
Columns arrange into 2 across without overlapping text or misaligned link lists.
Grid moves to 2-3 columns cleanly; no orphaned card alone on its own row edge overlapping the next section.
Sidebar and product grid don't overlap; check whether filters are still a drawer or now a fixed sidebar, and that the transition point looks intentional.
Typically 2-3 columns; price/compare-at price don't overlap; wishlist/compare icons on card don't sit on top of the image awkwardly.
Layout may switch from stacked to side-by-side here - check the transition point doesn't leave large gaps or overlapping columns.
Drawer width is proportionate to screen, not overly narrow or overly full-width; content doesn't feel cramped.
This is the usual sidebar breakpoint - confirm sidebar and grid columns don't fight for space (grid squished to 1 column, filter labels wrapping badly).

Section/Element: Sticky Add to Cart bar (if present)
What to Check: Sticky bar doesn't overlap footer or description content when scrolling.
Cart drawer overlay doesn't leave a visible gap or misaligned edge against the page content behind it.
Hero, carousels, and footer don't leave excessive empty side-margins or stretch images beyond intended max-width.
4+ column grid renders evenly; last row doesn't leave an oddly justified partial row.
Both columns align at the top; long descriptions don't push Add to Cart far below the fold unnecessarily.
Drawer doesn't look disproportionately narrow against a wide viewport; subtotal/checkout button stays visible without scrolling for a typical cart size.
